content: Kwanọng kw'ofon Shunẹm ọbhan k'obhon kwẹ

Wa Elisha okk'kwanọng nwa kw'iwa kẹ ọkkaan ọphyọbha nnwa kwẹ k'obo, obena bi, “Tzima ẹhọhmmọr chọ abina orenga atza awobha ibebaa k'ibe kpenamkpen s'afha awobha, okhuri bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ọgbaakha bi, okwo f'ideden f'ókwu ma owobha cho azenamfa.”
Kwanọng nwa ochina ororo osi mach'ọsẹjaakhi kw'Ibinọkpaabyi obeni. Kẹ ọmaana ẹhọhmmọr chẹ bẹ afona atza aruk k'ẹkhọma cha Philistiya, ka cho azenamfa.
K'okpong kwa cho mbuma azenamfa, ofona k'ẹkhọma cha Philistiya okhuna, otza ophyem bi, ọvaarnọng ọnang-ẹ ọhọhm kwẹ, ọmaana irerek.
Wa ọvaarnọng ọm-ọgbaak atzim ọnang Gehazi, kw'ode ọtzọhmnọng kw'ọsẹjaakhi kw'Ibinọkpaabyi, oben bi, “Gbaakh-m idik s'ibar-ọbar biphyir sa Elisha ọkk'ọsa.”

Mada Gehazi ọm-ọgbaak ọvaarnọng eden ch'Elisha ọkkaan ọphyọbha ọnọng kw'ọkk'ọpa k'obo, kwanọng nwa kw'ọkhaam nnwa kw'Elisha ọphyọbh k'obo opyiri bi, okwu ophyem ọvaarnọng ifha ọnang-ẹ ọhọhm kwẹ, ọmaana irerek. Gehazi oben bi, “Itta ọvaarnọng kwaam, kwanọng nwuma wọ ma e, nnwa kwẹ kw'ijinọng wọ ma, kw'Elisha ọphyọbh k'obo.”

Ọvaarnọng e, ọbọbh kwanọng nwa odik nwa, kwanọng nwa ọgbaakh-ẹ. Mẹ wọ ofon, ọvaarnọng oyeri ọkhaan-nọng kwẹ oben-ẹ bi, “Rọhng atza anang-ẹ ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'ode fẹ, attara k'iru biphyir s'ifon k'irerek sẹ, ttẹwọr k'ewu ch'iwa otte obhon nwa ọbọhk maa, apyiri ma.”
Hazayẹl ofhu ọvaar Bẹn-Hadad kwa Siriya
Wa Elisha ọtza Damaskọs bi, otza ore Bẹn-Hadad kw'ode ọvaarnọng kw'Aram kw'ọkhọhmana ọmma. Mada bẹ agbaakhi ọvaarnọng bi, “Ọsẹjaakhi kw'Ibinọkpaabyi okk'ofona k'odenmir okwu e,”
oben Hazayẹl kw'ode ọkhaanọng wani kwẹ bi, “Tzima ẹnanga atza are ọsẹjaakhi kw'Ibinọkpaabyi. Renga ma kẹ, adọhn Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi; abọbh-ẹ bi, ‘Na kaam mbina m'ọkhọhmana mva o?’ ”

Mando kwa Hazayẹl ọtzọk ẹnanga ch'ẹkkọkpo pya Damaskọs, py'akamẹl arọbh afa afha atzọhkha, ọtza ore Elisha. Mada opyiri, odim ọtza obe Elisha k'itzitzikha, oben bi, “Nnwa kwọ Bẹn-Hadad kw'ode ọvaarnọng kw'Aram wọ ọtzọhm-m bi, nkwu mbọbh-ọ bi, ‘Na kẹ obina k'ọkhọhmana f'ọmm-ẹ o?’ ”
Elisha obhina bi, “Rọhng atza gbaakh-ẹ bi, k'odik-ọkka, kẹ óbina k'ọkhọhmana mvuma obina. Ayongi mẹ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ẹjaakhi ọsa ọnang-m bi, kẹ ópe-ope e.”
Mando kw'ọsẹjaakhi ottim-ẹ chen maa, mgbar nsi Hazayẹl. Wa ọsẹjaakhi kw'Ibinọkpaabyi, ọttẹwọr obhom.

Mẹ wọ ofon, Hazayẹl ọn-ọbọbh bi, “Ode yan kw'itta kwaam on-obhomi ẹmọng o?” Ọsẹjaakhi obhina bi, “Okhuri bi, kaam nnong itzama s'ási anọng p'Israẹl kẹ. Kọ ákhe ibhon sabẹ, sa bẹ akk'abaabha ekpon, átzima ọkkangkkaang attaabh adikkobh pabẹ, átzọkha va-va pabẹ abun nho k'irerek, ábira átzaari panọng pabẹ p'atzim ọbhọhr ẹgagaangi afhu bẹ.”

Mẹ wọ ofon, Hazayẹl oben bi, “Yan kwa kaam ọtzọhmnọng kwọ, ọpfa-bukhi mach'aam mfha ńsi odik-barada-dema nwa o?” Elisha obhina bi, “Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'aam ọkhọhkha bi, kọ wọ áde ọvaarnọng kw'Aram.”
Mẹ wọ ofon, Hazayẹl obina oji Elisha ọbhana otzor itta kwẹ. Mada opyiri, Bẹn-Hadad ọbọbh bi, “Elisha ọgbaakh-ọ yan o?” Hazayẹl obhina bi, “Kẹ ọgbaakh-m bi, k'odik-ọkka, ábina ọkhọhmana mva obina e.”
Yina, ewu ehobh mẹ, ọtzọkha ibara s'idọhn-ọdọhni ọrana k'asi obubha ọvaarnọng k'itzitzikha maa, ọvaarnọng ope. Mando kwa Hazayẹl on-okwu ode ọvaarnọng.
Jehoram kw'ode ọvaarnọng kwa Juda
Ka cho kw'ottong azen kwa Joram kw'ode nnwa kw'ọvaar Ahab okk'Israẹl ọdabha, mẹ wọ kwa Jehoram kw'ode nnwa kwa Jehoshaphat ọttẹwọr ọdabh Juda.
Wa kẹ ode cho ẹrọbh obhiri jobh obhiri afa, k'ogbe kw'ode ọvaarnọng, ọdabh ẹvaar ka Jẹrusalẹm ka cho azenanttaan.
Wa osi idik otzor ka ndọhkhi s'avaar p'Israẹl. Osi itzama s'ẹhọhmmọr ch'Ahab ẹkk'ẹsa, iwa ọtzọkha ominanwa kw'Ahab k'ọbada. Wa osi ebibya k'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.

Ayongi mẹ, okhuri idadaakha s'ọkhaam ttara Devid kw'ode ọtzọhmnọng kwẹ, wa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kẹ kọdaakhi bi, odimi Juda. Wa kẹ okk'ochekhi bi, ohok iyaan sẹ imaani inang Devid, ọmaana va pa va pẹ maa, ogbe ode.
K'ogbe kwa Jehoram, wa anọng p'Edom arim anọng pa Juda abẹ, obhon kw'Edom orenga mẹ ọbhaangi ọn-ọkhaama ọvaarnọng kwẹ.

Wa Jehoram otzima akpaar pẹ pa nnyanyaang mmindọr biphyir, ochina ka Zair. Mando kw'anọng p'Edom akhọri kẹ ọmaana adenho p'akpaar pẹ pa nnyanyaang mmindọr akhe k'ottem. Yina, ọphyọbha k'erungi ọmaam bẹ m'ottem ọrọbh ofona; arim-egbong pẹ arọbh abhana ka bẹ k'ihọhm.
Wa Libna obiro orima egbong m'ogbe nwuma wani. Ttẹwọr kẹ maa, apyiri ma, anọng p'Edom am-arima anọng pa Juda abẹ.
Idik idọdọk s'ikhuri ẹvaar cha Jehoram, ọmaana idik s'osi, bẹ akkẹri sẹ ka nnwẹr kw'itzamadik s'avaar pa Juda.
Wa Jehoram ope, bẹ anọhng-ẹ ka mpekhubh s'ab'otte, k'odedenmon kwa Devid. Nnwa kwẹ Ahaziya on-ode ọvaarnọng.
Ahaziya kw'ode ọvaarnọng kwa Juda
Ka cho kw'ottong jobh obhiri afa kwa Joram kw'ode nnwa kw'Ahab okk'Israẹl ọdabha, mẹ kw'Ahaziya kw'ode nnwa kwa Jehoram ọdabhi ẹvaar ka Juda.
Iwa Ahaziya ode cho ẹrọbh obhiri afa mada ode ọvaarnọng, ọdabh Jẹrusalẹm ka cho wani. Wa ọkka kwẹ okpen Ataliya, kw'ode nnwa-mmona kw'Omri kw'ode ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl.
Wa osi idik otzor ka ndọhkhi s'ẹhọhmmọr ch'Ahab ẹkk'ẹsa, osi itzama s'ẹhọhmmọr ch'Ahab ẹkk'ẹsa k'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, wa ode ọnyẹ kw'ẹhọhmmọr ch'Ahab.
Wa Ahaziya obina ttara Joram kw'ode nnwa kw'Ahab, ọtza orima egbong ttara Hazayẹl kw'ode ọvaarnọng kw'Aram ka Ramọt-Gilead. Anọng p'Aram amuma Joram ekpo;

mẹ wọ osi, Joram kw'ode ọvaarnọng ofona ọbhana ka Jẹzrẹl, ifha okkeri for sẹ k'ekpo py'anọng p'Aram akk'ẹ amuma ka Rama, k'egbong ch'orim ttara Hazayẹl kw'ode ọvaarnọng kw'Aram. Mẹ wọ osi, Ahaziya kw'ode nnwa kwa Jehoram kw'ode ọvaarnọng kwa Juda, ọhakha ochina ka Jẹzrẹl bi, ọtza ore Joram kw'ode nnwa kw'Ahab, okhuri ekpo py'iwa bẹ akk'ẹ amuma.
